title: 00 — 五秒定位题型
markdown:
### 00 — 五秒定位题型

**Quiz 2：2026-11-09｜Unit 5/6｜50 points｜约 10–12 MC｜Open Notes（仅自己的 Notes）**。1102 明确排除新学的 RISC-V Assembly。A=老师 1102 明确列出/课堂活动；B=Lab L6/L7 变式，不保证每类单独出题。

| 英文题干关键词 | 对应 |
|---|---|
| speedup / parallelizable / sequential fraction / target speedup | §01 Amdahl |
| strong scaling / weak scaling / load imbalance | §01 Scaling |
| temporal / spatial / registers / L1 / L2 / L3 | §02 Hierarchy |
| cache size / line size / ways / sets / index / tag / offset | §02 Geometry |
| address / set index / same set / conflict | §02 Address |
| hit / cold miss / conflict miss / capacity miss / LRU | §02 Trace |
| hit time / miss rate / miss penalty / local miss rate | §03 AMAT |
| base CPI / accesses per instruction / stalls | §03 CPI |
| page size / virtual address / PTE bytes / flat page table | §04 Table |
| VPN / PFN / offset / physical address | §04 Translation |
| TLB hit rate / page walk / translation cost | §04 TLB |

**单位**：1 KiB = 1024 B；1 MiB = 2²⁰ B；每个 hex digit = 4 bits；百分比先转小数。**Hit Rate + Miss Rate = 1**。题目若要求 hexadecimal，不能直接填十进制。
